notes: open_geotiff(overview_level>=1) silently dropped CRS, transform attr, and georeferenced y/x coords because GDAL-style COGs (including to_geotiff output) write GeoKeys only on the level-0 IFD. Fixed by inheriting and rescaling georef from the level-0 IFD across all four read backends (#1640).
geoid_height_raster dropped input attrs and used dims[-2:] for 3D inputs (#1572). reproject/merge ignored nodatavals (rasterio convention) when rioxarray absent (#1573). Fixed in same branch.
